process.h2: How Packing Services Work in Boston

steps.title: Tell Us What to Pack
steps.text: The whole home or specific rooms. Mention anything fragile, heavy or valuable when you request a quote.

steps.title: Get It on One Quote
steps.text: A manager prices packing and the move together and explains the booking terms.

steps.title: Pack and Label
steps.text: The crew wraps fragile items, boxes each room and labels every box with the room it belongs to.

steps.title: Move and Unpack
steps.text: Boxes go to the matching rooms at the new home, and the crew unpacks if you've asked for it.

whyChoose.h2: Why Choose Better Life Moving for Packing Services in Boston?

cards.title: Wrapping Already in the Rate

cards.title: Rooms Labeled for Unloading

cards.title: One Quote for Everything

faqHeading: Packing Services FAQ for Boston Customers

faq.q: Can you pack only part of my home in Boston?
faq.a: Yes. Partial packing is common: many customers have us pack the kitchen and fragile items and do the rest themselves.

faq.q: Do you unpack at the new home?
faq.a: Yes. Add unpacking to your quote and the crew empties boxes and puts things away at the new place.

faq.q: Do you bring boxes and packing supplies?
faq.a: Yes. Packing supplies are part of our packing service, and blankets, shrink wrap and tape for furniture are included in the hourly rate of a local move.

faq.q: How do you pack dishes and glassware?
faq.a: Each piece is wrapped on its own and packed tight in a box marked fragile, so nothing shifts on the truck.
A manager sets the packing day and time with you when they price your move, based on how much there is to pack.

faq.q: Is packing worth it for a small apartment?
faq.a: Often, yes, for the kitchen and fragile items at least. Those rooms take the longest to pack well, and boxes packed by the crew go onto the truck quickly. You can pack clothes and books yourself and leave the rest to us, all on one quote.

faqClosing: Still have a question about packing? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.

closing.body: Tell us which rooms to pack and both addresses. Packing and the move go on one quote, and the crew that boxes your home is the crew that carries it.
